title: GitHub Actions artifact download fails with 403 Forbidden from intermediary during ListArtifacts
error_pattern: ##[error]Unable to download artifact(s): Failed to ListArtifacts: Received non-retryable error: Failed request: (403) Forbidden: Error from intermediary with HTTP status code 403 "Forbidden". Occurs on 'Download CLI archive' step in Polyglot SDK Validation (TypeScript, Node 22.x and 24.x), causing downstream 'Polyglot Validation Results / Check validation results' job to also fail.

occurrences.job: Tests / Polyglot SDK Validation / TypeScript SDK Validation (Node 24.x)
